cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The house is migrating south. Tell the surveyor I'll direct it away from the road.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He says it's subsidence. He's bringing concrete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You don't immobilize a migrating house halfway out. Ask him to leave a clear route; I'll guide him through it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His truck's already blocking the road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then have him drive slowly toward the empty plot. Slowly, please; we're leading a house, not delivering concrete.

reason: Use the actual surveyor remedy and truck position as targets for A's expert migration management.
